title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
factSummary: OpenAI’s Oracle customer story describes staff using ChatGPT Work and Codex for research and business questions. Reported time savings are customer examples, not a guarantee for every task; people remain responsible for outputs.

title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
factSummary: OpenAI reports banning accounts linked to two covert influence operations. One used fabricated journalist identities to submit articles. These findings concern identified operations, not all online writers or AI-assisted text.
